name: Surya Roshni Ltd
title: Surya Roshni Ltd - 500336 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 steel EBITDA/ton fell to ₹5,121 from ₹6,708 and FY27 guidance implies ~₹4,700/ton on 11 lakh tons, a sharp downshift management has not reconciled with its own export margin claims.

utilisation.quote: The capacity utilization of 78% to 80% was maintained throughout the year, even in a challenging operating environment.

capex.quote: In the last one and a half years, our capacity has improved by about 2 lakh tons. And in the next one year, we will reach around 1.6 million from 1.4.

triggers.label: Steel EBITDA/ton ₹6,708 → ₹5,121 YoY
triggers.quote: EBITDA per metric ton stood at ₹5,121 compared to ₹6,708 in the same period last year.

triggers.label: FY27 steel EBITDA/ton ~₹4,700
triggers.quote: we expect the EBITDA per ton to be around ₹4,700 for the whole year.

triggers.label: Capacity 1.4 → 1.6 mt in FY27
triggers.quote: in the next one year, we will reach around 1.6 million from 1.4.

triggers.label: FY27 volume 11 lakh t (+21-22%)
triggers.quote: we are targeting overall volume of 11 lakh tons, representing growth of nearly 21% to 22% over FY26

guidance.quote: we are targeting overall volume of 11 lakh tons, representing growth of nearly 21% to 22% over FY26
combined, the EBITDA for the whole year will be ₹680 crores to ₹700 crores.
In the whole year, we expect revenue of about ₹7,200 crores in the Steel Division.
we will be exporting more than 2.5 lakh tons this year
we are targeting value growth of 22% to 25% annually in Lighting and Consumer Durables segment overall
Our FY27 revenue target for the Wire and Cable business is ₹260 crores
